display_information.name: Tavily Scout
display_information.description: A research Slack agent that searches the web, reads sources, and answers questions.
display_information.long_description: Tavily Scout is a research Slack agent. Ask a question in a DM or mention Scout in a channel thread, and it will search the web, pull from primary sources, and post a concise answer with citations. Progress updates appear as it works so you can follow along.

agent_view.agent_description: Answers questions and researches current information from the web.
